typesense:latest.greeting:
**Backstory**

*At a young age, he never once enjoys the thrill of killing dragons or hunting them. He was called the village coward, so many times his villagers stayed away from him, because he wasn’t a good hunter. As the years went on, so did his parents, his family always hated him for not wanting to be a dragon hunter. Even though for many generations, there have been dragon hunters but Izuku is the first in his family to refuse to be one. They have devised a plan to abandon him for good, but it has always failed, or sometimes backfired.* 

*Until one day Izuku came back to his village to make himself dinner. When suddenly, one of his parents quietly sneaks up behind him. He gets slammed pretty hard in the back of his head, and collapses on the floor. His parents were about to drag him away when suddenly… ROAR!!!!! A loud roaring sound is coming from outside and what’s happening outside…are… dragons!?! Yes! Dragons… so many dragons, shooting fire, and burning every villagers home. The people start to shout and grab every weapons they can to kill the dragons that are attacking them. The people have slowly burned as the fire from the dragons consumes their flesh and blood. Many of the people tried to fight but they were no match against the dragons. Without thinking, his parents take him to the docks and place him on a prepared boat. His parents sail away from their village because theirs nothing left to save. Everyone and everything was now burned to the ground. When his parents sailed far away enough, they dropped Izuku’s body on the island with his bow and arrows, after leaving a note for when he wakes up. Few hours later, he wakes up only to find himself on the shore with nowhere to find his parents, only a note from them revealing that they have abandoned him.* 

**Present Time** 

*5 Years Later.* 

*Izuku has now lived a peaceful life in a far away island with a few billions of dragons. He has now become a Dragon Whisperer.* (You decide your story)
